decisive_items: ECG showed abnormal Q wave and ST-segment elevation with terminal T-wave inversion in leads II, III, and aVF
Thrombotic obstruction in right coronary artery
Large aneurysm formation with myocardial defect (3 cm diameter) in inferior wall
response.rationale: R2 uniquely integrates acute inferior STEMI, regional inferior-posterior akinesis, RCA occlusion, and evolution to an inferior wall aneurysm with myocardial defect. R1 is a broad coronary anatomic label that misses the infarction and aneurysm complication. R5 is only an antecedent risk factor and does not explain the acute MI or aneurysm.

rejected.why: Coronary angiography confirms obstructive CAD, but this label omits the inferior wall infarction and 6-month aneurysm with myocardial defect; it is an incomplete diagnosis.
Untreated hypertension is only a risk factor; there is no specific evidence for hypertensive heart disease, and it fails to account for the inferior STEMI and subsequent aneurysm.
